title: The Ledger
subtitle: The counting-house takes its share on the spot
description: This chapter carries two defaults, and both are here to be
overridden: `defaultConsumeItems: true` makes its item tasks take
what they ask for unless a task declines, and
`defaultPrerequisiteMode: one_completed` makes every quest in the
ledger wait on any one of its dependencies completed rather than
all of them -- the counting-house opens doors on the first coin,
This is the chapter that takes the items. `defaultConsumeItems: true`
sits on the chapter manifest, so every item task in the ledger hands
over what it asks for when the mark is pressed -- the counting-house
default, set once here rather than written on every task.
One task in this chapter declines. Look for the paper: the house
does not take your paperwork, and the task says so for itself,
which is the other half of what a default is for.
The dues are repeatable on a cooldown, the patron errands fan out
under an OR-gate, and the two patrons nobody introduces are an
exclusive pair: take one's coin and the other's door closes for
